digest.component_or_area: LLM workflow completion recovery and close gate
propositions: A ticket whose context exceeds 24,000 chars cannot transition to closed state via bounded recovery, blocking correct merged work with no path except --force-close.
The bounded-recovery failure incorrectly emits a false remedy ('install the agents extra') when the actual cause is step-budget exhaustion after the verifier ran model calls.
The context bound (24,000 chars) is mutually incoherent with the criteria bound (32,000 chars), allowing criteria sets that pass all criteria checks but fail on context validation.
Raising the context cap to 100,000 chars with a pinned invariant test ensures both real blocked tickets (34,282 and 41,595 chars) can complete while maintaining the fail-closed cost safeguard.

The failure diagnosis must be selected by cause rather than exception type so that recovery errors carrying diagnostic information report accurate sizes instead of generic missing-dependency guidance.
Context compaction via comment elision was rejected as a signed-false-PASS vector because on epics with graph=True it silently deletes whole child tickets and their unmet acceptance criteria.
